policy: Recover previous museum source JPEG bytes by exact recorded SHA256 and Git blob hash; no new museum search, painting selection or new assignments. NGA fetch is only the 2k IIIF rendition originally saved; SMK original image or thumbnail as served, not necessarily full native photograph. Two legacy assets transfer from immutable old repo commit. All copies are outside GitHub Pages site/ and retain original pixels. Failures remain explicit, never substitute photographs. Existing gallery display assets and prayer mappings untouched.
